FixtureType.name: RTI PIKO 55 - ProDMX Setup including Pattern Images

InfoItems.Info: Firmwareversion: 2022090502 IMPORTANT INFORMATION: This profile refers to the Professional DMX mode of the ShowNET mainboard inside the laser system. It is necessary to switch the laser mainboard to this mode. Use the ShowNET Admin Tool to do so. It is also possible to adjust further behavior of the laser and it is also possible to customize the content. Please find tools, different firmware versions and manuals on: www.laser-interface.com Color selection: Please be aware, that lasers have different features than conventional lighting devices. The Gobos of a laser can also be animated and come with standard coloring. Therefore the color selection is slightly different to conventional lighting: To activate an RGB color control it is necessary to activate ENABLE RGB in LCOLORMODE in order to set the R G B color selection active. Otherwise color selection can be done with the preset colors. Rotation effects: Use the effects generator to create awesome rotation effects. Use increasing or decreasing ramp shape for creating infinite rotation effects. Laser specifics: This profile also features Safety Zoning for lasers and color balancing. Please refer to the manual to learn more about this. Hint: If you use multiple units, try using effects generators for movement, gobos, resizing, color etc. to create stunning effects. Play with the phase shift of the effects - just like you would do with a large moving light setup.
